open_points.subject: M07 PublicationMark.marked_at
open_points.question: Which authoritative time source supplies the fresh instant written to `marked_at`?
options: a declared authority module wrapping the system clock
a timestamp supplied by the calling flow
open_points.default_guess: Use an injected UTC system wall clock.

witness.initial: A placement exists and has no publication mark.
events: The calling flow reports a Portal photo id.
The deliverer creates the publication mark.
outcomes: One implementation obtains `marked_at` from an injected system clock.
Another implementation accepts or derives `marked_at` from the calling flow.
witness.observer: A reader of the publication-mark record sees different instants.

open_points.subject: M07 PublicationMark.marked_at
open_points.question: Which event in the mark operation does `marked_at` denote: request receipt, acquisition of the project lock, successful Portal-photo validation, or creation of the mark record?
options: immediately before the mark record is written
open_points.default_guess: Use the instant immediately before writing the new mark record.

witness.initial: A placement exists, no mark exists, and another operation holds the project lock.
events: The calling flow submits a mark request.
The request waits for the project lock.
The lock is released much later and the mark is written.
outcomes: An implementation records the request-receipt instant.
An implementation records the instant at which the mark is written after the wait.
witness.observer: A reader of the publication-mark record sees materially different `marked_at` values.

open_points.subject: M07 PublicationMark.marked_at
open_points.question: In which representation must `marked_at` be stored and returned, including time zone awareness, UTC offset, precision and serialization form?
options: integer Unix time at a specified precision
open_points.default_guess: Store an aware UTC datetime serialized in ISO 8601 with `+00:00` and microsecond precision.

witness.initial: A placement exists and has no publication mark.
events: The calling flow records the publication.
The deliverer persists the new mark.
outcomes: One implementation writes a naive UTC datetime.
Another writes an offset-aware UTC datetime.
witness.observer: The record validator, a replay reader or an administrator inspecting the record sees different representations.

open_points.subject: publication-mark operation
open_points.question: How many readings of the decided time source may one mark operation take, and which reading supplies `marked_at`?
options: one reading before locking and another before writing, using the latter
open_points.default_guess: Take exactly one reading, immediately before constructing the new mark record.

witness.initial: A placement exists, no mark exists, and the clock advances while a mark operation waits for its project lock.
events: The mark operation begins and waits.
The operation acquires the lock and writes the mark.
outcomes: An implementation reads the clock once before waiting and stores that value.
Another reads it again after acquiring the lock and stores the later value.
witness.observer: A reader of the publication-mark record sees different `marked_at` values.

open_points.subject: A6 rule 2 state-path naming
open_points.text:
In the state folder the lock file of a project is named by its project id with the
   imported `LOCK_FILE_SUFFIX` constant, in the folder of the imported `LOCKS_FOLDER` constant; a placement
   record and a mark record are named by the source id with the imported `RECORD_FILE_SUFFIX` constant, in
   a folder named by the project id inside the folder of the imported `PLACEMENTS_FOLDER` or `MARKS_FOLDER`
   constant.
open_points.question: Which textual representation of the UUID project id is used in lock-file names and project-folder names?
options: the spelling received in the request
open_points.default_guess: Use the canonical lowercase hyphenated UUID representation.

witness.initial: A confirmed connection exists for UUID `123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000`, and no state entries exist for it.
events: A caller addresses the project and performs a delivery.
The service creates the project lock and state folders.
outcomes: One implementation creates `locks/123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000.lock` and matching hyphenated project folders.
Another creates `locks/123e4567e89b12d3a456426614174000.lock` and matching unhyphenated project folders.
witness.observer: The installer, an administrator, or a later compatible implementation sees different durable paths.

open_points.subject: A6 rule 4 lock-file opening
open_points.text:
It is opened for reading and writing,
   created when absent, without following a link, and given the mode of `LOCK_FILE_MODE` each time it is
   opened, whatever the umask; a failure to set that mode is refused like a lock file that cannot be
   opened. An entry at its address that is a symbolic link or not a regular file is refused like a
   lock file that cannot be opened.
open_points.question: For an existing entry, must the service verify that it is a regular file before changing its mode, or may it set the mode first and then refuse it as non-regular?
options: verify regular-file type before changing the mode
set the mode before verifying the type
open_points.default_guess: Open without following links, verify the opened object is a regular file, and only then set its mode.

witness.initial: The lock address contains a FIFO with mode 0666 rather than a regular file.
events: A caller starts a delivery for the project.
The deliverer opens the existing FIFO for reading and writing without following links.
outcomes: An implementation checks the opened type first, refuses it and leaves mode 0666.
An implementation sets mode 0600 first, then checks the type and refuses it.
witness.observer: The caller receives the same refusal, but an administrator inspecting the state folder sees whether the malformed entry was changed.

open_points.subject: A6 rule 4 lock-file mode
open_points.text:
given the mode of `LOCK_FILE_MODE` each time it is
   opened
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: The passage must name this policy value as the imported `LOCK_FILE_MODE` constant.
